services.name: Zoo & Wildlife
services.desc: Lucky Ladd Farms is home to part of a unique ecosystem found only in middle Tennessee called the Tennessee Cedar Glades. They occur in areas where limestone bedrock is present at or near the surface, with shallow soil and harsh conditions. Remarkably, the Cedar Glades are native to about a dozen rare plant species that have specially adapted to thrive in this desert-like ecosystem including the endangered Tennessee coneflower, lyrate bladderpod and Nashville breadroot to name a few. Lucky Ladd Farms has developed a series of walking trails through the Cedar Glades on the farm that feature interpretation signage and interactive educational activities.
